name: Equipment Checkout
description: The club's gear closet — an inventory of org-owned equipment, who has what checked out, due dates, and the full lending history per item.

source.query: SELECT c.id AS id, e.name AS title, NULLIF(e.identifier, '') AS subtitle, c.due_date AS when_at, c.member_id AS member_id, 0 AS done FROM app_equipment_checkout__checkouts c JOIN app_equipment_checkout__equipment e ON e.id = c.equipment_id WHERE c.returned_at IS NULL AND c.due_date = :today ORDER BY c.checked_out_at LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_equipment_checkout__checkouts WHERE returned_at IS NULL AND due_date <> '' AND due_date < :today LIMIT 1
